title: NVIDIA H100在Intel TDX下的机密GPU推理基准测试
summary: 本文对NVIDIA H100 GPU在Intel TDX机密计算模式下的LLM推理性能进行了基准测试。使用Mistral-7B和Qwen3-30B-A3B模型，机密模式导致首令牌延迟增加21.8%-27.8%，全局吞吐量下降17.7%-21.1%，且大模型更早达到饱和。结果表明机密推理在负载下仍可用，但需考虑性能损失和饱和行为。
summary_en: This paper benchmarks confidential GPU inference on NVIDIA H100 under Intel TDX using Mistral-7B and Qwen3-30B-A3B. Confidential mode increases TTFT by 21.8%-27.8% and reduces throughput by 17.7%-21.1%, with larger models saturating earlier. Results show usable throughput under load but require capacity planning for performance penalties.
